name: Mihara Kyouko
source: A transfer student who transferred into the school alongside [url=/c136004]Takachiho Makoto[/url] by mistake. She is a genius violinist, and is so skilled that she plans to study abroad in Europe after graduation. She has a gentle personality, and she seems to like [url=/c129116]Sensei[/url] from the first moment they meet.
